message.content:
The volume \(V\) of a cone is given by

\[
V=\frac{1}{3}\pi r^{2}h
\]

where  
\(r = 3 \text{ cm}\) (base radius) and  
\(h = 5 \text{ cm}\) (height).

Plugging in the values:

\[
V = \frac{1}{3}\pi (3)^2(5)
   = \frac{1}{3}\pi (9)(5)
   = \frac{1}{3}\pi (45)
   = 15\pi
\]

So the exact volume is \(15\pi\) cubic centimeters.

Numerically,

\[
15\pi \approx 15 \times 3.14159 \approx 47.12 \text{ cm}^3
\]

**Answer:** The volume of the cone is \(15\pi \approx 47.12\) cubic centimeters.
